summary: Iteration 9 — SECTION 2 auth + buyer dashboard audit. All 17 backend tests PASS (100%). Verified FLOW 3 (stale-cookie session expiry redirect), FLOW 4 (6/6 unauth protected-route redirects including dealer & admin), FLOW 5 (admin signin returns totpEnabled flag + admin/dashboard blocked by pre-MFA cookie alone), FLOW 6 (PART A affiliate register: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on missing ftcDisclosure, 201 with AL######-regex referral code on valid payload, 409 EMAIL_EXISTS on duplicate including the pre-existing manual record). FLOW 1 & FLOW 2 (buyer signup/signin) are implemented as Next.js server actions (RSC-encoded POST) and cannot be exercised by an HTTP client; instead verified (a) buyer sign-in/up pages render, (b) redirect=/buyer/dashboard query param round-trip, (c) the existing test buyer row in Prisma has correct defaults plan=STANDARD, onboardingComplete=false. Prisma verification also confirmed a fresh User(role=AFFILIATE) + Affiliate(status=PENDING, level=1, referralCode=ALT61HXJ) pair was created by the test (b) run — proving PART A writes both DB rows atomically.
critical_code_review_comments: proxy.ts — CSRF exemption list now covers /api/buyer, /api/dealer, /api/affiliate, /api/admin; /api/affiliate/register correctly passes through without csrf-token (verified by FLOW 6 success).

/api/admin/auth/signin — returns 200 with {success, requiresMfa, totpEnabled} and sets httpOnly pre-MFA cookie (al_admin_pre_mfa) with 10-minute TTL. /admin/dashboard is gated by full admin session cookie, so pre-MFA cookie alone correctly produces a redirect to /admin/auth/*. Good defense-in-depth.

/api/affiliate/register — referral-code generator uses crypto.randomBytes(6) with a 36-char alphabet and retries up to 5x on collision. Regex AL[A-Z0-9]{6} is enforced by the generator and verified live. Transaction wraps User+Affiliate creates; on failure Supabase user is best-effort rolled back via admin.deleteUser — correct compensating action.

One observation (non-blocking): on Supabase createUser failure the route returns generic SIGNUP_FAILED/500; error message heuristic (/already|registered|exists|duplicate/i) maps to EMAIL_EXISTS. Consider switching on err.code (e.g. 'email_exists') once Supabase guarantees stable codes — message parsing is brittle across versions.

Buyer signup/signin are server actions with no stable HTTP surface, so they cannot be smoke-tested by curl or pytest. Consider adding a thin JSON route (POST /api/auth/signup, /api/auth/signin) that server-action wrappers call — this would make future regression testing trivial and give mobile/native clients a stable contract.
